title: Every claim carries a recovery status and a separate mathematical status

statements.text: The author grades every claim of the framework. Its mathematical status (open, conditional, closed, obstructed or superseded) is kept apart from whether it has been recovered into the dependency graph, and in the Atlas each claim carries one standing: primitive, derived, recovered, selected, effective, conditional, open or rejected. No claim is promoted by interpretive agreement alone.
statements.scope: the grading used in the July 2026 rebuild and the Chronoflux Atlas

sources.quote: I separate recovery status from mathematical status. A node may be completely recovered while its claim remains open, conditional, obstructed or superseded.
Every authority carries one explicit scientific standing.
No authority is promoted by interpretive agreement alone.
